payload.test_receipts: 22/22 pass, stable across 3 runs (66/66) on hatch-vm linux, 2026-10-11T05:43Z. 8 original acceptance cases + 9 regression tests keyed to the 5 static findings + 5 supporting.

findings_addressed.1_reuse: dispatch.Coordinator IS ui_controller_v7.Coordinator (identity-asserted in tests); every transition acquires coordinator.gate; all writes via Coordinator._journal_append. No substitute class, no parallel lock.
findings_addressed.2_restart_uncertainty: Outcomes carry applied/uncertain/refused; startup holds intents with no/uncertain outcome. Damaged journal -> quarantine + durable .failed_closed sentinel; second startup stays held. trusted_resume (gate-held) is the only clear path.
findings_addressed.3_fence: Hold checks inside the gate; ANY hold blocks ALL dispatches (any op_id) and ALL transfers. Old allow-new-op-under-hold test deleted, replaced with refusal tests.
findings_addressed.4_durable_authority_lifetime: Admission/approval/lease/revocation journaled and reconstructed; spend append-only per ref; 8h max-age + 30min idle on injectable clock; journal OSError fails closed.
findings_addressed.5_binding_validation: Fake observed-identity binding (no pipe); per-op schemas; canonical byte equality enforced.

bugs_found_in_testing: trusted_resume lease re-establishment dropped live lease (fixed via v7 force_release/acquire)
same op_id re-dispatch after hold clear (fixed with single-use duplicate guard)
interpretations: dispatch checks IPC lease mirror, not v7 lease token (v7 lease gives exclusivity at admit/transfer)
register/approve/revoke allowed under hold (add/remove authority only; no dispatch until trusted_resume)
admin ops removed from frames allowlist (owner-internal, not client verbs)
